name: unauthorized-models
description: The same AI/ML API 401 envelope as `unauthorized-get`, for the ONE GET that carries a query string: `aimlapi#models` pins `?include=pricing` at the binding, and replay matches on method AND url, so the roster needs its own chain. Captured 2026-10-15 against /v1/key with a deliberately invalid key; the body is identical because the gateway's 401 envelope does not name the path.

body.title: Unauthorized
body.message: This request requires a valid API key. You can create a new API key on the Billing page: https://aimlapi.com/app/keys

error.name: UnauthorizedException
error.message: This request requires a valid API key. You can create a new API key on the Billing page: https://aimlapi.com/app/keys
